tei:div.tei:p: )gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i bsgom bzlas bde ba can gyi zhing du bsgrod pa'i gdams pa bya rgyal khyung gi rta pho bzhugs so//

na mo shākya mu ne ye: tshe dpag med pa'i yum mchog gos dkar mo// rab tu khros pa lha mo 'di yin pas// bde ba can du skye ba de yi don// ma mgon lcam dral dam la btags pa'i phyir// thub pa'i gtsug tor las ni lha 'di sprul// byad kha bzlog par zab pa de yin no// zhal nas ma gsungs thub pa'i gtsug tor nas// mdo dang gzungs kyi sgra grags gtsug tor zer// 'di nyid bya ba'i rgyud ni yin na yang*// bya rgyud bla med ltar du nyams len pa// dza tā ri dang rdo rje gdan pa sogs// grub chen mang pos mdzad ltar nyams len bde// dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas// bi ma mi trar brgyud pa rnying ma'i lugs// gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i gter ma dang*// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho brgya rtsa'i rgya gzhung dang*// mthong ba don ldan dbang phyug rdo rje sogs// bod gzhung tshad ldan rnams kyi bcud bsdus te// nyams len bde zhing byin rlabs che ba 'di// nad gdon byad ka gtad mnan zlog pa la// rdo rje pha lam ral gri nyid dang mtshungs// bde ba can gyi zhing khams bsgrod 'dod na// bya rgyal khyung la chibs nas 'gro dang mtshungs// de phyir 'di la rgyun khyer nyams len mdzod// āḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med stong pa nyid// oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i gdugs dkar yongs gyur las// dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med rang nyid ni// rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog chen mo'i sku// dbu stong mdun zhal sgeg pa nyis brgya dkar// g.yas zhal nyis brgya 'jigs rung dgod pa ser// rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po gshed dang rngams// g.yon zhal ljang khu nyis brgya snying rje zhi// steng zhal sngon po nyis brgya drag la gtum// dbu rer rdo rje'i mtshan rtags spyan gsum gsum/ sku mdog dkar zhing spyan mig bye ba 'bum// zur mig bsgrad dang glog ltar drag tu gzigs// g.yas phyag lnga brgya g.yon phyag lnga brgya yis// thams cad bsam chod ral gri 'bar ba phyar// zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyang pas 'jigs kun mnan// zhabs g.yon lnga brgya bskums pas gdon kun mnan// sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun cod paṇa 'phyang*// dbu gtsug gdugs dkar bdun ni brtsegs mar 'khor// ba spu thams cad ye shes 'od zer 'bar// lha rdzas na bza' zhi khro'i rgyan dang ldan// dpral bar rnam snang thugs kar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par snang mtha' thugs kar āḥdamar po// thugs smad rdor sems thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// thugs dbus zla steng oṃ yig dkar po'i mthar// sngags phreng 'od kyis sgrib bsal mthu stobs rgyas// ya so khro bcu ma so khro mo bcu// sma ra me dpung ral gri ngar ma'i lce// mgrin par nyi zla rang lus me dpung 'bar// gnod byed thams cad gzhob thul bsreg par gyur//

de yan mngon rtogs blo la ma zin kyang*/ dmigs pa bsgom pa kho nas chog pa ste/ bsgom pa tsam gyis mnan gtad ngag mnan sogs/ grol bar gu ru khrag 'thung nag pos gsungs/ 'di ni ngag tu 'don pa gal che'o// hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo// phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo// dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can// rdo rje yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ kun nas bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la nyin dang mtshan du bsrung du gsol lo// tād+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bai re bai re/ so me so me/ badz+ra dha ri ni bhan+dha bhan+dha: badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: hūm̐ drum̐ bhan+dha phaṭa: ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: bdag dang bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa thams cad phyes phyes: khrol khrol: mnan pa dang bcings pa bsdams pa thams cad sarba a pā na ye swā hā: zhi ba shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pa'i bar de rab bdun 'bring lnga dang*// tha ma tshar gsum tsam ni brjod pa'i rjes// snying po dang ni nye snying sngags 'di gnyis// rang gis gang mos bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hāḥ snying po'o/ oṃ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā: nye ba'i snying po'o: 'di ltar bsgom bzlas byas pa'i bsod nams kyis// mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas// sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog / de nas sgom mkhan sems la hrig ger blta/ ci yang ma mthong ngang du sa ler bzhag /rgyun du dmigs pa la sogs mi gsal yang*// sngags thung gnyis po spyod lam kun tu 'don// kye ma tshe sngon bsod nams dman pa'i mthus// zos pa med pa'i dom yig zer ba'i dpe// byas pa med kyang gtad yig nang du thebs// ban bon mang po'i mthu gtad zhabs su song*// na tsha rkyen ngan mang pos rgyun du mnar// 'chi ba dran cing dam chos 'dod na yang*// dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skal pa med// nam 'chi cha med 'chi ba bzlog thabs med// shi nas gar 'gro cha med a tsa ma// rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal che// de 'dra yid la dran mkhan mi yod na// gdams pa 'di la rgyun du thugs dam mdzod// sngon tshe chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis// mtha' dbus mkhas pa brgya rtsa gdan drangs nas// bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur thams cad bod du bsgyur// de dus rgyal po'i sku rim byad bzlog la// bka' 'gyur nang nas 'di las zab ma snyed// rgyal po'i sku rim byad bzlog 'di la byas// rgya gar mu stegs rgya nag ha shang dang*// bod kyi bon pos brub kyang gnod ma nus// dus phyir sog po o rong rgyal po des// 'di la rgyun du thugs dam zhal 'don mdzad// kar bstan rtsad nas brlags kyang gnod ma nus// de phyir byad bzlog 'di las zab pa med// gzhan yang 'di yi gzungs nas gsungs pa'i don// shin tu bsdus te tshigs su bcad smra na// sangs rgyas bye ba grangs med du ma yis// byin rlabs bsod nams rang gis thob par gsungs// mtshams med lnga dang las kyi sgrib pa rnams// thams cad ma lus byang zhing dag par 'gyur// rang gi tshe dang bsod nams stobs cher 'phel// nam zhig 'di nas 'chi 'phos gyur ma thag

/bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar gsungs// tshe 'di'i rkyen bzlog phyi ma zhing khams thob// phyir mi ldog pa gtan gyi 'dun ma ste// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob la thag nye ba// 'di 'dra rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir// rā ga a s+yas gzhung dang man ngag bsdebs// pad+ma mthar phyin zhes byas yi ger bris// 'di la sngags sgra ma dag nor 'khrul sogs// mchis na ye shes spyan ldan rnams la bshags// dge bas 'gro kun bar chad rkyen zhi nas// phyi ma bde chen zhing du skye bar shog /skyes nas gzhan don dpag med 'grub par shog// /
